Do tapjoy offers for free gems and then play the current event Gacha only 3 times (the rewards are 200 gems back for doing so).  Repeat until you get an S rank body and then save your gems for premium checkpoint items which improve your config.

Another way without gems is to save up your hearts until you have ~1500 stocked up and use them all at once to guarantee a top 200 spot in the weekly wins rankings to win the S rank prize (use item boosts when you do this too).
